say:2:1421528001:1.text: So, that's the good part we can use! But... it's so tiny.
say:2:1421528001:1.source_cn: 剩下的材料就是可以做剑柄的材料了嘛！可是……好小！

say:3:1421528002:1.text: Is it really enough for the hilt?
say:3:1421528002:1.source_cn: 这么小的一块木头，真能做成剑柄吗？

say:4:1421528003:1.text: It is, as long as I don't make any mistakes...
say:4:1421528003:1.source_cn: 不出任何错的前提下，勉强够用……

say:5:1421528004:1.text: Still, I won't have any room to carve patterns on the hilt...
say:5:1421528004:1.source_cn: 可是这样我要怎么雕刻剑柄的造型呢……我原本想在剑柄上做...

say:6:1421528005:1.text: Carving?! Chippy thinks there isn't enough wood for that!
say:6:1421528005:1.source_cn: 这样小的木头上还要做雕刻？！满满觉得这样材料会不够的！

say:7:1421528006:1.text: I can do hollow carving... but it'll make the hilt lighter...
say:7:1421528006:1.source_cn: 如果是镂空雕刻的话，我可以用现有的材料完成……只是剑柄...

say:8:1421528007:1.text: The sword is a weapon. To Chippy, practicality and comfort matter the most!
say:8:1421528007:1.source_cn: 满满觉得剑作为武器，最重要的是实用性！是作为武器的手感！

say:9:1421528008:1.text: Chippy thinks it's unwise to sacrifice practicality for looks!
say:9:1421528008:1.source_cn: 如果为了美观而舍弃实用性……满满不认可这种做法！

say:10:1421528009:1.text: But carving is an important part of craftsmanship. Since this is a competition, I have to showcase my carving skills to the judges...
say:10:1421528009:1.source_cn: 可雕刻是显示工匠技术的重要一环，毕竟这是比赛，我不得不...

say:11:1421528010:1.text: The patterns we carve reflect our sense of aesthetics... If all the swords look the same, how are the judges supposed to decide the winning sword?
say:11:1421528010:1.source_cn: 雕刻还代表了一个工匠的审美……如果大家的作品都一模一样...

say:12:1421528011:1.text: Chippy... Chippy isn't good with words, but you said you wanted to see things from the user's perspective when you approached us!
say:12:1421528011:1.source_cn: 满满……满满说不过你！可满满记得你一开始请我们帮忙的时...

say:13:1421528012:1.text: The sword is only truly perfect when its user thinks so!
say:13:1421528012:1.source_cn: 满满觉得，只有使用者觉得这把剑完美！它才是真的完美的武器！

say:14:1421528013:1.text: As a user, Chippy would always prefer a practical sword over a beautiful one!
say:14:1421528013:1.source_cn: 满满说的都是自己作为使用者真实的感受！满满更喜欢实用的...

say:15:1421528014:1.text: Chippy likes a weapon with a soul!
say:15:1421528014:1.source_cn: 满满喜欢的是有灵魂的武器！

say:16:1421528015:1.text: I get it now. I totally understand how you feel, Chippy.
say:16:1421528015:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。我完全理解满满你的感受了。

say:17:1421528016:1.text: Have you decided not to carve the hilt?
say:17:1421528016:1.source_cn: 你放弃在剑柄上雕刻的想法啦！

say:18:1421528017:1.text: After taking a closer look at the wood, I decided to do some hollow carving at the end of the hilt...
say:18:1421528017:1.source_cn: 我又看了一下这块木料……还是决定在握柄的尾端做一些镂空...

say:19:1421528018:1.text: You didn't listen to what I said at all...
say:19:1421528018:1.source_cn: 我说的你根本没听进去嘛……

say:20:1421528019:1.text: It is up to the user who holds the weapon in their hand to judge whether it's perfect, not the craftsman or the public...
say:20:1421528019:1.source_cn: 剑是否完美，不取决于锻造它的工匠，也不取决于他人的眼光...

say:22:1421528020:1.text: Chippy—I mean, Master Chippy—it's precisely because of your advice that I decided to carve.
say:22:1421528020:1.source_cn: 正因为尊重满满小兄弟……不，是满满师父的感受，我才决定...

say:23:1421528021:1.text: I just gave this piece of ironwood a feel and noticed it was denser, and therefore heavier, than the usual hilt wood.
say:23:1421528021:1.source_cn: 我刚才掂量了一下这块铁藜木的重量，发现它比常用作剑柄的...

say:24:1421528022:1.text: For the sake of practicality, I have to reduce its weight with some hollow carving...
say:24:1421528022:1.source_cn: 出于实用性的考虑，为了让使用者手感更加舒适，我必须通过...

say:25:1421528023:1.text: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
say:25:1421528023:1.source_cn: 原来是这样！主人，不知道为什么，满满突然觉得好高兴！
say:25:1421528023:1.male: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
say:25:1421528023:1.female: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!

choice_prompt:26:1421528023.text: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.source_cn: 原来是这样！主人，不知道为什么，满满突然觉得好高兴！
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.male: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!
choice_prompt:26:1421528023.female: I see! Chippy's pleased to hear that!

say:27:1421528024:2.text: Let's give Vaun some time to tie up the loose ends!
say:27:1421528024:2.source_cn: 我们给瓦恩留点时间，让他把剩下的工作完成吧！

choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 瓦恩对锻造这门手艺感悟更深了
